description.value: A Subway franchise sandwich shop located on the south end of Williams Lake, a key service hub along the Cariboo Highway corridor. It offers customizable Footlongs, wraps, and salads with fresh-baked bread and vegetables, with options for dine-in, curbside pickup, and delivery. For touring cyclists riding through the Cariboo, this is a reliable and filling stop in a town that serves as a major resupply point for routes north and south.

address.value: 1196 Broadway Avenue South, Williams Lake, BC V2G 1A2

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active Subway franchise at 1196 S Broadway, Williams Lake, BC V2G 1A2 with phone (250) 398-7800, matching the OSM record.
